name: ModelViewer-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The astronaut faces forward and reads most clearly as a full model, with its helmet, backpack and red accents visible.

tagline: An astronaut model turns slowly on a black stage.
summary: A 3D model floats in the middle of an empty dark viewport and rotates on its own. Visitors can drag to turn it and scroll to zoom.
appearance: A small white astronaut figure with a backpack, dark visor and red and blue accents stands alone against black. It is lit softly from the front with a faint shadow beneath its feet.
behaviour: The model spins slowly and continuously on a vertical axis. Dragging over the viewport turns it by hand with inertia, and scrolling or pinching zooms in and out.
demo_content: A white astronaut model, about a third the height of the viewport, on a black background.
search_phrases: glb model viewer for a landing page
use_when: A product, character or asset needs a simple in-page 3D turntable.
avoid_when: It loads a remote model file and needs WebGL, so it is heavy for a small decorative spot.
customise: The model URL, size, light intensities, environment preset, default rotation and zoom, drag, hover and parallax options, auto-rotate and screenshot button are all props.
weight_why: A three.js scene with environment lighting and contact shadows redrawn every frame while it spins.

a11y.note: The canvas has no keyboard control or text description of the model, and auto-rotation ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The model floats small in a mostly empty black viewport with no framing hint.
polish_why: A crisp turntable with good soft lighting; the empty frame around the model feels bare.
